## Create table subtraces

### functions

```{r}

sub_traces <- read.csv("../../../data/helper/26-02-26-search-list-comment-functions.csv", header = FALSE)$V1 |> paste(collapse=("|"))
sub_traces_light <- sub_traces$V1[!sub_traces$V1 %in% c("even", "odd")] %>% paste(., collapse=("|"))


get_sites <- function(sphere_){
  df <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.sha1, t.crawl_date, t.site, t.url, t.sphere FROM sites t WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND t.of_interest = TRUE"), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(subdomain = urltools::domain(url) %>% suffix_extract(.) %>% select(subdomain) %>% pull(.),
           site_subdomain = paste(site, subdomain, sep = "_") %>% as.character(.),
           simple_date = paste0(year(crawl_date),"-", month(crawl_date), "-01") |> ymd())
}

get_sites_comments_histo <- function(sphere_){
  df_comments <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.sha1, t.sphere, t.id_date_site_subdomain FROM traces_context t WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' "), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(simple_date = str_extract(id_date_site_subdomain, "^\\d{4,4}-\\d{1,2}-01") %>% as_date(.),
         site_subdomain = str_remove(id_date_site_subdomain, "^\\d{4,4}-\\d{1,2}-01_")) %>%
  reframe(counted_comments = n(), .by = c(site_subdomain, simple_date))
  
  df <- get_sites(sphere_) |> 
    reframe(counted_sites = n(), .by = c(site, site_subdomain, simple_date)) |> 
    left_join(df_comments)
}

get_script_sub_traces <- function(sphere_){
  
  script_trace_ids <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.tags_id FROM traces t WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND t.tag = 'script' AND t.comment = 'embedded'"), check_interrupts = TRUE) #|>  paste(collapse=("|"))
  
    df <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.site as sha1, t.tag, t.tags_id, t.sphere, t.value as raw_trace FROM tags t WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND t.tag = 'script' AND t.embedded is not null AND t.value ~* '", sub_traces_light, "'"), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>% 
    filter(tags_id %in% script_trace_ids$tags_id) |> 
  mutate(trace = str_extract(raw_trace, regex(sub_traces_light, ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  # select(-column_t) 
  mutate(search_type = "sub_traces",
         comment = "value") 
}

get_data_sub_traces <- function(sphere_, search_in){
  df <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.sha1, t.tag, t.sphere, t.",search_in," as raw_trace FROM traces_context t WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND t.",search_in," ~* '", sub_traces, "'"), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(trace = str_extract(raw_trace, regex(sub_traces, ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  # select(-column_t) 
  mutate(search_type = "sub_traces",
         comment = search_in) 
}


```

### building data

```{r}

sphere_ <- "German"
sphere_ <- "World"
sphere_ <- "Dutch"

translation_sites <- read_csv("../../../data/4-doc/sites/de_site_subdomain_category.csv")
translation_sites <- read_csv("../../../data/4-doc/sites/world_site_subdomain_category.csv")

df_sites_histo <- get_sites_comments_histo(sphere_) 

# test <- get_sites("German")

df_sub_traces <- get_data_sub_traces(sphere_, "value") %>% #View()
  bind_rows(., get_data_sub_traces(sphere_, "attr")) %>% 
  # bind_rows(., get_data_snippets_traces_("value", sphere_)) %>%
  # bind_rows(., get_data_snippets_traces_("attr", sphere_)) %>%
  bind_rows(., get_script_sub_traces(sphere_)) |> 
  left_join(get_sites(sphere_)) %>% 
  reframe(counted_traces = n(), .by = c(site_subdomain, site, simple_date, trace, search_type)) %>% 
  arrange(simple_date) |> 
  left_join(translation_sites) |> 
  mutate(site_category = if_else(!is.na(category), paste0(site,"_", category), site_subdomain))

found_traces <- df_sub_traces %>% select(trace) %>% distinct()# %>% pull(.)
found_sites <- df_sub_traces |> select(site_category) |> distinct()

print_data_subfindings <- seq(ymd("1997-01-01"), ymd("2021-09-01"), by = "month") %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  rename(simple_date = value) %>% 
  expand_grid(., found_traces) %>%  #View()
  left_join(., df_sites_histo) %>% #View()
  left_join(., df_sub_traces) %>% #View()
  mutate(is_set = ifelse(!is.na(counted_traces), 1, NA),
         sphere = sphere_) %>% #View()
  group_by(site_subdomain, trace) %>% 
  fill(is_set, .direction = "updown") %>% 
  fill(site_category, .direction = "updown") |> 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(is_set == 1) %>% # View()
  # mutate(site_category = ifelse())
  filter(site_category %in% found_sites$site_category) |> 
  select(-category, -is_set)

dbWriteTable(conn = con, name = "tbl_gfx_subfindings", print_data_subfindings, append = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(con_sqlLite, "tbl_gfx_subfindings", print_data_subfindings, append = TRUE)

```

## Create table all findings

### functions

```{r}

get_annotated_data <- function(sphere_){
  annotated_data_raw <- read_csv(paste0("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/", SPREADSHEET_ANNOTATION[[{sphere_}]]), show_col_types = FALSE) |> filter(!is.na(site))
        annotation_is_empty <- annotated_data_raw %>% nrow() == 0
        # check_gs_empty(annotated_data)
        if(!annotation_is_empty) {
          annotated_data <- annotated_data_raw %>% 
            filter(tooltip_info != "") %>% 
            mutate(type = "manual research",
                   date = paste0(year, "-", ifelse(is.na(month), "1", month), "-", ifelse(is.na(day), "1", day)) %>% ymd(.),
                   # technology = ifelse(is.na(technology), "other", technology),
                   shape_color = 9999999,
                   shape_fill = NA#,
                   # shape_nr = 19
                   ) %>% 
            rename("crawl_date" = "date") %>% 
            select(crawl_date, site, type, shape_color, shape_fill, tooltip_info)
        }
        else{
            annotated_data <- annotated_data_raw %>% 
            mutate(type = "manual research",
                   date = NA_Date_,
                   site = NA_character_,
                   tooltip_info = NA_character_,
                   shape_color = NA,
                   shape_fill = NA#,
                   # shape_nr = NA
                   ) %>% 
            rename("crawl_date" = "date") %>% 
            select(crawl_date, site, type, shape_color, shape_fill, tooltip_info) 
        }
        return(annotated_data)
        }

get_snippet_data <- function(sphere_){
  df_return <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.sha1, s.site, s.url, t.trace, t.sphere FROM sites s INNER JOIN traces t ON s.sha1 = t.site WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND t.search_type = 'snippet_list'"), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(subdomain = urltools::domain(url) %>% suffix_extract(.) %>% select(subdomain) %>% pull(.),
                 site_subdomain = paste(site, subdomain, sep = "_") %>% as.character(.),
                 type = "traces via snippet detection",
                 shape_color = NA,
                 # shape_nr = 23 %>% as.character(.),
                 tooltip_info = paste0("Snippet: ", trace),
                 # archive_url = paste0("http://web.archive.org/web/", str_remove_all(as.character(crawl_timestamp), "-|\\s|:"), "/", url)
                 ) %>% 
          mutate(shape_fill = cur_group_id(), .by = "trace") |> 
    select(crawl_date, site, site_subdomain, type, shape_color, shape_fill, tooltip_info)
}

get_hashed_findings <- function(sphere_){
  # sphere_ <-  "German"
  df_return <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.agg_id, t.hashed_context FROM context_hashed t WHERE t.iteration ='monthly_whitelist' AND t.sphere = '",sphere_,"' "), check_interrupts = TRUE) |>
    mutate(site_subdomain = str_remove(agg_id, "\\d{4,4}-\\d{2,2}-\\d{2,2}_"),
                 site = str_remove(site_subdomain, "_.*$"),
                 crawl_date = str_extract(agg_id, "\\d{4,4}-\\d{2,2}-\\d{2,2}"),
                 crawl_date = ymd(crawl_date) , 
                 type = "traces via tag findings") %>%
          # filter(site == current_data$site_to_load) %>%
          arrange(crawl_date) %>%
          mutate(
            nr_unique_hashes = match(hashed_context, unique(hashed_context)), .by = "site_subdomain"
            ) |> 
  mutate(
            # nr_unique_hashes = dense_rank(hashed_context), .by = c(site, subdomain),
            shape_color = nr_unique_hashes,
            shape_fill = NA,
            # shape_nr = 19,
            tooltip_info = paste0("tagindex: ", nr_unique_hashes)) %>%
          select(crawl_date, site, site_subdomain, type, shape_color, shape_fill, tooltip_info)
}


df_return <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.sha1, s.site, s.url, t.trace, t.sphere FROM sites s INNER JOIN traces t ON s.sha1 = t.site WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND s.site ='cbc'"), check_interrupts = TRUE)

df_return <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.sha1, s.site, s.url, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.sphere FROM sites s INNER JOIN traces_context t ON s.sha1 = t.sha1 WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND s.sha1 ='0ac2c91419f24491669a3ffce269e7be4b10cf37'"), check_interrupts = TRUE)
```

## Create table corresponding tags to hashes

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| message: false

sphere_ <- "German"
sphere_ <- "World"
sphere_ <- "Dutch"

df_ids <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.agg_id, t.hashed_context FROM context_hashed t WHERE t.iteration ='monthly_whitelist' AND t.sphere = '",sphere_,"' "), check_interrupts = TRUE) |>
  mutate(site_subdomain = str_remove(agg_id, "\\d{4,4}-\\d{2,2}-\\d{2,2}_"),
                 site = str_remove(site_subdomain, "_.*$")) |> 
          # filter(site == current_data$site_to_load) |> 
  arrange(agg_id) |> 
          mutate(nr_unique_hashes = match(hashed_context, unique(hashed_context)), .by = "site") |> 
          reframe(agg_id = first(agg_id), .by = c(nr_unique_hashes, hashed_context, site, site_subdomain)) |> 
          select(-hashed_context)

db_ids <- df_ids$agg_id |> paste(collapse=("|"))

df_archived_sites <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.crawl_timestamp, s.site, s.url, t.id_date_site_subdomain FROM sites s INNER JOIN traces_context t ON s.sha1 = t.sha1 WHERE t.sphere = '",sphere_,"' "), check_interrupts = TRUE) |>
  filter(id_date_site_subdomain %in% df_ids$agg_id) |> 
   mutate(archive_url = paste0("http://web.archive.org/web/", str_remove_all(as.character(crawl_timestamp), "-|\\s|:"), "/", url)) %>%
          arrange(crawl_date) |>
          select(id_date_site_subdomain, archive_url) |> 
          reframe(archive_url = first(archive_url), .by = c("id_date_site_subdomain")) # |>
          
        

df_db_table <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.id_date_site_subdomain, t.tag, t.attr, t.value, t.value_cleaned_whitelist, t.sphere FROM traces_context t WHERE t.sphere = '",sphere_,"' "), check_interrupts = TRUE) |>
  filter(id_date_site_subdomain %in% df_ids$agg_id) |> 
  mutate(site_subdomain = str_remove(id_date_site_subdomain, "\\d{4,4}-\\d{2,2}-\\d{2,2}_"),
                 site = str_remove(site_subdomain, "_.*$"),
                 crawl_date = str_extract(id_date_site_subdomain, "\\d{4,4}-\\d{2,2}-\\d{2,2}"),
                 crawl_date = ymd(crawl_date),
                 type = "traces via tag findings") %>%
          left_join(., df_ids, by = c("id_date_site_subdomain" = "agg_id", "site" = "site", "site_subdomain" = "site_subdomain")) |> 
          arrange(crawl_date) |> # View()
          select(site, site_subdomain, tag, attr, value, value_cleaned_whitelist, nr_unique_hashes, id_date_site_subdomain, sphere) |>
          distinct() |> 
          left_join(df_archived_sites) |> 
          mutate(archive_url = paste0('<a href= "', archive_url,'"  target="_blank">Link ins Archive</a>')) %>% 
          select(-id_date_site_subdomain)#, archive_url) # %>%

dbWriteTable(conn = con, name = "tbl_context_hashed_tags", df_db_table, append = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(con_sqlLite, "tbl_context_hashed_tags", df_db_table, append = TRUE)

```


## Create table crawl time

```{r}
df_return <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT * FROM sites s WHERE s.of_interest = TRUE"), check_interrupts = TRUE) |> 
          # filter(site == !!current_data$site_to_load) %>% 
          mutate(hour = hour(crawl_timestamp) %>% as.numeric(),
                 year = year(crawl_date) %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
          group_by(sphere, site, hour, year) %>% 
          summarise(counted = n()) %>% 
          ungroup() %>% 
          # collect() %>% 
          mutate(counted = as.numeric(counted))

dbWriteTable(con_sqlLite, "tbl_crawl_time", df_return, append = TRUE)


```

## Create table snippet findings data

```{r}
df_table_snippet_findings <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT s.crawl_date, s.site, s.url, s.crawl_timestamp, t.trace FROM sites s INNER JOIN traces t ON s.sha1 = t.site WHERE s.of_interest = TRUE AND t.search_type ='snippet_list' "), check_interrupts = TRUE) |> 
  
  # tbl(pool, "sites") %>%
  #         filter(site == !!current_data$site_to_load) %>% 
  #         inner_join(., tbl(pool, "traces"), by = c("sha1" = "site")) %>%
  #         filter(search_type == "snippet_list") %>% 
  #         select(site, crawl_date, trace, url, crawl_timestamp) %>% 
  #         collect() %>% 
          arrange(crawl_date) %>% 
          mutate(snippet_group = cur_group_id(),
                 snippet_group_member = row_number(), .by = c("trace", "site")) %>% 
          filter(snippet_group_member < 6) %>% 
          mutate(archive_url = paste0('<a href= "http://web.archive.org/web/', crawl_timestamp, '/', url,'"  target="_blank">Link ins Archive</a>')) %>% 
          select(site, trace, crawl_date, url, archive_url)

dbWriteTable(con_sqlLite, "tbl_snippet_findings", df_table_snippet_findings, append = TRUE)

```

## Create table histogram

```{r}

df_historiograms <- read_csv("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/historiograms/visual analyses - traces of commenting options - Tabellenblatt1.csv") |> View()
  filter(type %in% c("offsite", "onsite", "meta")) |> 
  select(-comment, -archive_link, -screenshot) %>% 
          filter(type != "meta") %>% 
          mutate(continuous_group = cur_group_id(), .by = c(site, type)) %>% 
          mutate(closed_groups = ifelse(lead(continuous_group) != continuous_group, "last", "same"),
                 closed_groups_start = ifelse(lag(continuous_group) != continuous_group, "first", "same"), .by = site) %>% 
          mutate(closed_groups = ifelse(is.na(closed_groups), "last", closed_groups),
                 closed_groups_start = ifelse(is.na(closed_groups_start), "first", closed_groups_start),
                 date_blurred = floor_date(date,unit ="month"),
                 change = ifelse(closed_groups == "same" & closed_groups_start == "first", T, F)) %>% 
          mutate(index = cumsum(change), .by = site) |> 
  summarise(start_date = first(date), end_date = last(date), .by = c(site, index, type)) %>% 
          mutate(blurry_start = start_date - months(6),
                 blurry_end = end_date + months(6)) |> 
  mutate(start_date = start_date |> as.character(),
         end_date = end_date |> as.character(),
         blurry_start=blurry_start |> as.character(),
         blurry_end = blurry_end |> as.character())

dbWriteTable(con_sqlLite, "tbl_historiogram", df_historiograms, append = TRUE)
dbRemoveTable(con_sqlLite, "tbl_historiogram")

df_historiogram_comments <- read_csv("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/historiograms/visual analyses - traces of commenting options - Tabellenblatt1.csv") |>

dbWriteTable(con_sqlLite, "tbl_historiogram_comments", df_historiogram_comments, append = TRUE)
```
